_comment: Static configuration tables for datasets/real_estate/listings.py. Zillow robots.txt allows /homes/for_sale/, /homes/for_rent/ and /homes/recently_sold/ browse paths for the generic agent; the modern /homes/{location}_rb/ and /homedetails/ paths are not on the allow-list, so the compliant URL forms are used. Redfin GIS status codes: 9 = active, 1 = rental, 11 = sold. Redfin region ids (region_type=6) are only those verified against the live GIS endpoint; extend via PRY_REAL_ESTATE_REDFIN_REGION_IDS.
